sanskrit_verse: स्त्री निषेधे शतं दद्याद् द्विशतं तु दमं पुमान् । प्रतिषेधे तयोर् दण्डो यथा संग्रहणे तथा ॥
transliteration: strī niṣedhe śataṃ dadyād dviśataṃ tu damaṃ pumān / pratiṣedhe tayor daṇḍo yatha saṃgraheṇa tathā //
sph_interpretive_translation: When a woman is obstructed in her svadharma or rightful action, the compensation due is one hundred units; when a man is similarly obstructed, it is two hundred. If both are obstructed together, then the penalty follows the same principle as in their joint undertaking.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in alignment with svadharma, not in gender alone
Causation arises from obstruction to conscious capacity, not from identity markers
Capacity-based responsibility scales with energetic and societal role alignment
Restoration logic demands recompense proportional to disruption of dharma-flow
Consciousness alignment requires rectification of distorted participation
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A obstructs agent B's svadharma THEN compute restitution based on B’s functional capacity within dharma-field
IF obstruction occurs jointly THEN apply multiplicative integration factor equivalent to unified causal field strength
IF gender is used as sole determinant for restitution THEN override with svadharma-weighted assessment protocol
IF damage is to collective dharma-expression THEN aggregate individual compensations under shared-consciousness modulus
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in identifying who disrupted the flow of another's svadharma. Gender is not determinative; rather, the court must assess each party's alignment with their respective roles in sustaining sanatana dharma. Authority flows from consciousness-integrity, not social positioning.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that obstruction distorts anupūrvaśaḥ—the sequential unfolding of right action. Thus, justice lies in restoring continuity, not inflicting pain. Responsibility aligns proportionally with the degree of interference, while reparation ensures completion of interrupted dharmic momentum without punitive attribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svadharma Reclamation Process wherein obstructed party receives energetic and material support to resume intended function
Deploy Consciousness Completion Cycle where both parties undergo alignment recalibration through guided realization
Activate Shared Dharmic Reconstruction Protocol if obstruction involved mutual engagement fields
Establish Dharma Flow Monitoring System to prevent recurrence via early detection of energetic misalignments
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Obstruction is dissolved by restitution aligned with svadharma. No punishment exists—only completion. Reality abides in non-retaliation. Consciousness remains the ultimate judge.
